description: Works out paint for a room (walls, ceiling, woodwork from length, width, height, doors and windows), an exterior (perimeter x height plus gables, less openings) or a custom list of areas. Shows areas, coats, indicative coverage per surface type, litres, litres with waste and the tins to buy (least paint left over, plus a fewer tins option). New plaster adds a mist coat; a light over dark colour change adds a wall coat. Coverage is indicative: pass the tin's figure as coverage_m2_per_litre to make it exact. Example: {"job":"room","length_m":4,"width_m":3.5,"height_m":2.4,"doors":1,"windows":1}.

areas.description: Custom: list of { name, area_m2, surface, coats, coverage_m2_per_litre }. At most 100.

colour_change.description: light_over_dark and strong_colour add one wall coat.

coverage_m2_per_litre.description: Spreading rate from the tin, used for every wall and ceiling line.

gables.description: Exterior: gable triangles above the eaves line (width at the base, height to the ridge).

height_m.description: Wall height floor to ceiling, metres. Defaults to 2.4.

job.description: Defaults to room, or exterior if perimeter_m is given, or custom if areas is given.

openings_m2.description: Exterior: total area of doors and windows to take off.

paint_woodwork.description: Default true (skirting, door faces and frames, window frames).

perimeter_m.description: Exterior: total length of walls to paint, metres.

tin_sizes_l.description: Tin sizes on offer, litres. Defaults by product: emulsion 10, 5, 2.5, 1; masonry 10, 5, 2.5; trim 2.5, 1, 0.75, 0.5.

trade.description: Optional. The decorator's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill quotes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Brush Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Fresh Coat Decorators".

licence_body.description: Trade body or accreditation the business belongs to (pda = Painting and Decorating Association).

licence_number.description: Membership or registration number with that body.

wall_coats.description: Defaults to 2 (plus a mist coat on new plaster).

wall_surface.description: Surface of the walls. Room default smooth_painted; exterior default masonry_smooth. smooth_painted: Previously painted smooth plaster or plasterboard (12 m2/L); new_plaster: New bare plaster (porous, needs a mist coat) (9 m2/L); bare_plasterboard: Bare plasterboard (10 m2/L); lining_paper: Lining paper (11 m2/L); textured: Textured coating or woodchip (7 m2/L); masonry_smooth: Smooth render or painted masonry (7 m2/L); masonry_rough: Pebbledash or rough cast (4 m2/L); bare_brick: Bare brick or block (5 m2/L); woodwork: Woodwork top coat (gloss, satin, eggshell) (15 m2/L); wood_primer: Primer or undercoat on bare wood (12 m2/L); metal: Metal paint (railings, gates, radiators) (12 m2/L); wood_stain: Exterior wood stain or treatment (12 m2/L)

waste_percent.description: Added to the litres before choosing tins. Defaults to 10.

windows.description: Number of windows at the 1.2 x 1.2 m default size. Defaults to 1. Ignored if window_sizes is given.

woodwork_bare.description: Adds a primer or undercoat coat on the woodwork.

woodwork_coats.description: Top coats on woodwork, defaults to 2.

name: paint_quantity
title: Paint litres and tins
